whyThis.metaDescription: Why ATM RADAR exists, how it works, and what its limits are.
whyThis.title: Why This?
whyThis.intro: ATM RADAR helps people check whether an ATM is likely to have cash before they travel to it.

problem.title: The Problem
problem.body: People often travel to ATMs without knowing whether cash is available. They may waste time waiting in queues or travelling to an ATM that has no cash.

solution.title: Our Solution
solution.body: ATM RADAR helps you discover nearby ATMs on a map and review recent availability information before you visit. Each ATM shows its reported status, where the report came from, when it was made, and how reliable it is.

how.title: How It Works
how.step1: Find an ATM using the map, area search, or PIN code.
how.step2: Review its reported availability, source, and timestamp.
how.step3: Check the reliability label and whether the report is still valid.
how.step4: Submit a community observation after personally checking an ATM.
how.step5: Open directions to the selected ATM.

transparency.title: Data Transparency
transparency.body1: ATM RADAR currently uses sample ATM records and simulated statuses. These are not live bank data.
transparency.body2: Community reports are unverified observations and do not guarantee current cash availability.

security.title: Security and Privacy
security.item3: collect card PINs or account details
security.more: Read the full Privacy / Disclaimer page

purpose.title: Project Purpose
purpose.body: This project has an educational purpose. It demonstrates full-stack development, REST APIs, MongoDB, interactive maps, multilingual interfaces, and responsible handling of location-related information.

limits.title: Limitations and Future Scope
limits.item1: Live bank integration is not available.
limits.item3: ATM location coverage depends on the sample dataset.
limits.item4: Any future bank integration would require authorized APIs and appropriate security review.

privacy.metaDescription: What information ATM RADAR uses and what it does not promise.
privacy.title: Privacy / Disclaimer
privacy.intro: This page explains in plain language what information ATM RADAR uses and what it does not promise.

disclaimer.title: Disclaimer
disclaimer.body: ATM RADAR currently shows sample ATM records and simulated statuses. They are not live bank data. Community reports are unverified observations. An Available status does not guarantee that cash is present, and an Unavailable or Unknown status does not guarantee that it is absent. Do not rely on this site for urgent or important decisions. This site is not affiliated with any bank.

collect.title: What we collect
collect.item1: Account details: your name, your email address, and a password that is stored only as a salted hash. The password itself is never stored and cannot be seen by us.
collect.item2: Reports you submit: the ATM, the status you chose, and the time. A report is linked to your account to limit spam, and it is not shown to other people with your name.
collect.item3: A login cookie that keeps you logged in for about a week. It is used only for login.

location.title: Your location
location.body: If you press Find ATMs near me, your browser asks for permission and shares your approximate position. The position is sent to the server once as part of the search so that nearby ATMs can be found. ATM RADAR does not save it and keeps no location history. Your hosting provider may keep ordinary server logs of requests. You can use area and PIN code search without sharing your location.

browser.title: Saved in your browser
browser.body: Your language and light or dark mode choices are saved in your browser (localStorage). They are not sent to the server.

thirdParty.title: Other services
thirdParty.body: Map tiles come from OpenStreetMap, which receives your IP address and the map area you view. If you open directions, Google Maps opens in a new tab and its own privacy policy applies. ATM RADAR has no advertising and no analytics.

retention.title: How long data is kept
retention.body: Reports are deleted automatically after 7 days. Account details are kept until the account is deleted.

not.title: What we do not collect
not.body: Card numbers, card PINs, bank account details, or precise location history.

choices.title: Your choices
choices.body: You can log out at any time, block location access in your browser, and clear saved preferences in your browser settings. To ask for your account to be deleted, email the developer at the address in the footer. There is no self-service deletion page yet.

terms.metaDescription: The terms for using ATM RADAR.
terms.title: Terms and Conditions
terms.intro: By using ATM RADAR you agree to these terms. ATM RADAR is an information service. It is not a bank and it does not handle money.

use.title: Using the service
use.body: You may use ATM RADAR to look up ATMs and to submit honest reports based on your own observation. You must not submit false reports, send spam, try to break or overload the service, or use it for anything unlawful.

accounts.title: Accounts
accounts.body: You are responsible for keeping your password private and for activity under your account. Give accurate details. Accounts that misuse the service may be limited or removed.

content.title: Reports you submit
content.body: Reports must reflect what you saw yourself. By submitting a report you allow ATM RADAR to show its status, time, and source to other users. Reports are unverified and may be removed.

accuracy.title: No guarantee of accuracy
accuracy.body: Statuses, locations, and times may be simulated, outdated, or wrong. Do not rely on ATM RADAR for urgent needs. You use the information at your own risk.

affiliation.title: No bank affiliation
affiliation.body: ATM RADAR is not connected to, endorsed by, or acting for any bank. Bank names appear only to describe sample ATM records.

changes.title: Availability and changes
changes.body: The service may be changed, paused, or removed at any time without notice. These terms may be updated, and the date at the top shows the latest version.

liability.title: Limits of liability
liability.body: To the extent allowed by law, the developer is not responsible for losses that come from using or not being able to use this service.

questions.title: Questions
questions.body: For questions about these terms, email the developer at the address in the footer.
